technology_name: Ni-Ti SMA-Steel-Polypropylene Hybrid Fiber-Reinforced Upcycled Cementitious Composite
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
technology_type: Smart Shape Memory Alloy Composite / High-Performance Concrete
problem_solved: Standard high-performance concrete lacks crack closing memory properties and structural resilience under dynamic cyclic fatigue stresses.
description: A high-performance hybrid fiber upcycled cementitious structure combining Ni-Ti shape memory alloy (SMA) fibers, steel fibers, and polypropylene fibers suspended inside a GGBS and Ordinary Portland Cement (OPC) 53 grade binder mix.
applications: Seismic-resistant high-rise building cores, smart bridge deck joint overlays, blast-resistant infrastructure, and self-centering seismic structural elements.
secondary_sector: Energy, Climate & Sustainability, Infrastructure, Construction & Smart Cities
